protocol.primary: snippet: identical unmodified PCM samples as the heuristic; reconstructed mono PCM16 WAV header
protocol.diagnostic: context: feature extraction from original whole waveform, using the same independently selected target window; scored separately
protocol.crop: Independently select target word immediately before ABOVE; select its initial stop and following vowel from words/phones tiers; start 25 ms before stop start, end at following vowel end. Manual vot tier is used only for scoring.
protocol.labels: null; zero placeholders only, no gold VOT supplied to feature extraction or inference
protocol.frameConvention: Upstream wrapper conversion: window start + index / 1000. 5 ms windows, 1 ms step; no 2.5 ms center correction.
protocol.endRounding: Frontend input end rounded down to integer milliseconds, at most <1 ms shorter
protocol.negativeCompanion: PG legacy classifier aliased byte-identically to .pos. All-zero BB .neg supplied to satisfy loader, ignored with -pos_only.
protocol.modelScore: Uncalibrated structured margin; not a probability

limitations: 58 target /p b/ recordings, positive VOT only; speakers/native languages not verified
Native decoder forces an output for a known stop window; output coverage is not reliable detection or a false-positive test
Conditional MAE uses different denominators; compare all-case threshold success and the shared 16-case subset
Training overlap unverified; PGWords may share the source collection
No pronunciation grading, microphone validation, Mandarin, negative VOT, or other consonants tested
No native model has replaced the live browser detector
assessment: Neither pretrained model is validated for reliable automatic measurement on these inputs.
